items.title: Eddie B. Edwards Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: after you had this band going with Seberg and uh Vanaselli

ctx.x: oh oh I'm going back to that now somebody replaced Signorelli I'm thinking yes uh Henry Vanaselli oh yes that's the guy I was trying to think of
